input.quote: EXCEPT FOR LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8 OF THIS AGREEMENT, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED THE TOTAL AMOUNT ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO HEREUNDER FOR THE TRANSACTION WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES TO DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE FILING OF THE CAUSE OF ACTION TO WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES.
input.rationale: Section 9 is facially mutual and excludes indirect/consequential damages, but it fails the fallback on two material terms. First, the cap base is not 12 months' fees: it is limited to amounts "ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO ... FOR THE TRANSACTION WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES TO", which reduces the cap to a per-transaction slice of fees and can fall well below six months' fees. Second, the only carve-out is "LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8" (Commerce One's IP indemnity, which in any event runs only in our favour); there is no carve-out for breach of the confidentiality obligation in Section 10 / the concurrent NDA, gross negligence or wilful misconduct, all of which the fallback requires. Our redline keeps the mutual structure, sets the cap at the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and US$1,000,000, adds an Excluded Claims definition covering indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement, and confirms Corio's fee obligations are not capped damages. Note also the duplicated/garbled text at p0092 should be deleted as a scrivener's error in engrossing.

ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE TOTAL AMOUNT PAID OR PAYABLE BY CORIO HEREUNDER DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE LIABILITY AND (B) ONE MILLION U.S. DOLLARS (US$1,000,000). "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8 OF THIS AGREEMENT, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS UNDER SECTION 10 OF THIS AGREEMENT OR THE RELATED NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. CORIO'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE HEREUNDER SHALL NOT BE SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have kept the cap mutual but set it at the greater of twelve months' fees paid or payable and US$1,000,000, and removed the "transaction which the liability relates to" narrowing, which would otherwise reduce the cap to an illusory amount. Our position is that indemnification and confidentiality breaches, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and that Corio's payment obligations are not capped damages; if helpful we can accept a straight twelve-month fee cap provided those carve-outs remain.
proposal.summary: Make the mutual cap the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and US$1,000,000, and add Excluded Claims carve-outs (indemnity, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement).
